messages:
Rae (People Ops): Quick drop  a tiny 'Goal + Feedback coach cards' pack for managers running fast cycles. Copy/paste friendly.

Cal (Eng Manager): Love concise stuff. can you add a 1-line manager opener I can read aloud in a 1:1?

Rae (People Ops): Yep. Added a 1-line opener + a 3-bullet self-review micro and a 2-question peer form. Kept char limits.

Mina (SWE): 2 Q peer form sounds great. can it be anonymous?

Rae (People Ops): Yes anonymous by default. Also added a one-line calibration paste for meeting notes.

ops-bot: Reminder: performance window opens in 3 days  see /perf for deadlines.

Rae (People Ops): [COACH CARDS  copy/paste]
1) Manager opener (say this in a 1:1): "Thanks for the work this cycle  highlight one win, then one development ask."

2) Self-review micro (ask IC to paste 3 bullets, <=140 chars each):
- Top contribution: [outcome + metric/link]
- Biggest learning: [what changed in how you work]
- One ask: [how manager can help next cycle]

3) Peer feedback (2 quick Qs, anonymous):
- Q1: One strength? (<=80 chars)
- Q2: One suggestion to improve? (<=100 chars)

4) Manager calibration paste (1 line each person):
- "Employee / Level / Rating (E/M/NG) / 1-line evidence / Main risk"
Example: "Mina / SWE II / M / Reduced p95 by 30% via batching / Risk: docs missing"

Cal (Eng Manager): Perfect. I'll paste the opener at the top of my 1:1 agenda and enforce the char limits on the form.

Rae (People Ops): Thanks  I'll drop this into the kickoff doc and the manager playbook. DM me if you want an editable slide. :sparkles:
